Analysis of your 1,663 settled phone bets (Sep 25-Oct 16; the engine's own 127 orders are too few, only 5 settled, net -$0.32):
LOSING (sample big enough): player prop OVERS n=527, ROI -15%, -$97.6, t=-3.4 (NFL 290: -11%, NHL 179: -15%, WNBA 29: -25%, MLB 49: -22%); NBA spreads/other n=71 -40%; bets 3-13 h before start n=533, -13 to -18% (t=-3.4 at 6-13h); EV 4-6% bets -15% (t=-2.4, the bigger the claimed edge the worse = traps).
WINNING / flat: NCAAF spreads +27% (n=73, t=1.3, not yet proven), game totals Overs +22% (n=89, t=1.2), bets within 1 h of start +2.3% with CLV +2.9%, prop Unders only -4% (t=-0.3).
Odd point: CLV is +1 to +2% on the losing props, so the close says the price was good but results lag: part is variance, part is that prop Overs are shaded by books after the line.
The engine already cuts prop Overs 7 pts and trap-guards >6 h. Another Claude session holds the repo lease right now so I can't edit; I'm leaving the proposal for it: tighten/stop prop Overs (t=-3.4) and cap EV>4% props, keep NCAAF/totals, then re-test at 200 engine-graded bets. Tell me 'force' if you want me to make the change myself now.
